failedPlayerObservations.scope: Selected frames from a failed full route; not yet recorded as opened
observations: All 15 extracted frames individually opened by Codex. Pocket-arrival/settled include the whole straight animal and both separated ships; collar modules are small at this scale and the lips are subtle.

Five dialogue samples show the correct alternating Sela/Taren portraits and changing expressions with in-progress typewriter text. The panel covers the ships but leaves the animal visible. These do not show every fully revealed line or establish continuous readability.
The return frame shows separated ships with no thrust command. CSV shows that the route passes the intended waypoint but settles 16.08 m away. This needs input/arrival diagnosis.

Six combat/failed-exit frames show the actual curved animal, independent selected link HUD and live ships. Nearby mooring hardware sometimes overlaps their projected silhouettes. Taren charge stays at zero; the failed exit still has one link. No release occurred, so no release-quality claim is available.

playerObservations.anchorScope: Last sample of resolving checkpoint, not an exact lethal timestamp. Six evenly spaced conversation samples do not guarantee all six lines.
observations: Pocket approach/settled: both small separated ships and the whole straight dormant animal are visible. Four moorings dominate; animal/collar detail is too small and pocket folds too subtle. Quiet-preview composition REJECTED as final map quality.
Pocket return: both ships remain framed and separated at rest. This selected image does not establish continuous braking feel.

Conversation 0 has partial typewriter text; 1-5 show complete subsequent lines, correct alternating portraits and readable panel. The panel covers the ships while the actual animal remains visible above. No claim that all six full lines were read from these samples.

Combat turn and mid-combat: both ships are separated from each other and the animal; visible shots/damage numbers and 100 charge support resumed combat input. These are selected states, not balance acceptance.

Release +0.20/+0.85: animal, separated ships and detached restraint pieces remain visible; contextual Taren bark is readable but crosses anatomy. The +0.20 objective still shows the lock, then +0.85 shows the warp.
Release +1.50: whole animal and both ships remain framed, but Sela's left silhouette appears to meet/overlap the body. This is a remaining visual spacing concern, not proof of physical contact.

Release +1.80: animal leaves the top after the bounded hold; ships remain fully visible. +2.75/+3.20: ships separated and framed with bark below. Continuous camera return and movement remain UNVERIFIED.
